purpose: Revision-2 fixed-protocol, independent-seed replicate campaign, run end to end through the deterministic LangGraph control plane (orchestration/langgraph/run_graph.py) rather than the retired multi-agent worker-prompt path. Replicate 1 of each system LOCKS the protocol; replicates 2 and 3 replay it verbatim with different seeds.

this_box.gpus: 4x NVIDIA A800 40GB (GPU 0 held by another user's job; 1-3 in use here)

sibling_box.note: Run elsewhere by the operator; parameters not defined by this manifest.

method.replicate_1: Full graph: classify -> make_deterministic_plan run-plan --with-ff-probe -> headless literature-grounding critic -> headless adjudicator (SKILL.md step 5) -> materialize_plan -> cost guard -> execute, with the engine's own bounded recovery (MAX_AGENT_DECISIONS=2) inside execute.
method.protocol_lock: On WorkflowEngine status 'accepted', run_campaign calls write_characterization_cache.py, which freezes workflow_state.effective_parameters -- decided_params AS AMENDED BY EVERY MID-RUN REMEDY -- under FREEZE_KEYS into guides/system_characterization_cache.json, keyed by isomeric-canonical SMILES.
method.replicates_2_3: cache_probe hits that entry, make_plan_from_cache writes plan_mode='deterministic'/confidence 'high', and the graph routes past classify, critique, adjudicate AND materialize straight to the cost guard and execute. Skipping materialize is required for correctness: it would re-solve the cell and overwrite the protocol just replayed.
method.failure_policy: A replicate 1 that does not reach 'accepted' STOPS the system's campaign and is reported to the operator. escalation_required and failed are terminal -- both recovery-agent calls are spent by then, so re-entering only re-burns GPU.

seed_derivation.why_not_pinned: Neither seed is in write_characterization_cache.FREEZE_KEYS, so a replayed protocol carries no seed and each replicate derives its own from its run_name -- distinct per replicate, stable across retries. That is the mechanism that makes 'same protocol, different seed' structural rather than clerical.
seed_derivation.note: Both seeds derive from the SAME sha256 digest under different moduli. stereo_r2 pinned independently-derived seeds instead; here the values are whatever the run_name yields, recorded below BEFORE first execution so they can be checked against what actually ran.
seed_derivation.verify_after_run: emc_seed in data/<RUN>/attempts/build/<id>/executor_state.json; velocity_seed in the equilibration attempt's executor_state.json.

deviations_from_stereo_r2: stereo_r2 pinned bm_pressures_atm [-1000, 0, 1500, 3000, 5000] for PEEK and PSU because PKTN and PSFO declare no ladder. Here nothing is pinned: protocol_policy resolves the ladder at run time from the cell's own measured CED and fluctuation K (unscreened default (-200, 0, 3000, 7000, 15000), tension widened to at most -1000 atm once CED is measured). That is why 'murnaghan' prices as unpriced for both. WATCH: the 15000 atm compression point is ~30% volume strain on a K~5 GPa glass; a kink or a poor Murnaghan fit on PEEK/PSU should be read against this choice first.

stereo_r2 used the --no-llm/--baseline arm, arguing a fixed-protocol claim should not rest on a critic pass that is not rerun for replicates 2-3. Here replicate 1 runs the critic and the adjudicator, and what they decide is frozen into the cache -- so replicates 2 and 3 inherit the reviewed protocol verbatim without re-running either model.

stereo_r2 stated polymer_class per system because a PVC dyad misclassifies as PHAL. None of these four has that problem: classify_cli returns PHYC / PKTN / PSFO / POXI for the four SMILES, verified 2026-09-11, so run_graph's own classify node is used.

host_calibration.why: hardware_policy carried a 4x Quadro RTX 6000 / 18-core fingerprint, so host_matches() was false and every cost estimate came off another machine's throughput curve at 'medium' confidence. Revalidated with --size-points before pricing any run in this campaign.
host_calibration.parity: run-0 vs CPU PASS for all three families; values_are_benchmarked=true.

seed_verification.method: emc_seed read from data/<RUN>/attempts/build/<id>/executor_state.json; velocity_seed read from the `velocity all create` lines of the equilibration attempt's generated decks, which is where it actually reaches LAMMPS.
seed_verification.note: The pre-registered run_name-derived values are what reached the build and the decks, with no pinning in the plan. stereo_r2 records that round 1 never closed this loop; it is closed here per replicate, and must be re-checked for replicates 2 and 3, where it is the ONLY thing that distinguishes them from replicate 1.

errata.claim_as_written: "COMPASS is not a runnable field in this codebase (no 'compass' entry in forcefield.RUNNABLE_FIELDS / ENUM_OVERRIDES['preferred_ff'])" -- the adjudicator's DECISIVE argument for keeping pcff on PSU.
errata.evidence: forcefield.FIELDS['compass'] exists (front_end=emc, styles lj/class2/coul/long + class2 bonded), LINEAGE['compass']='class2' so it IS in RUNNABLE_FIELDS, and scientific_control.FF_OVERRIDE_VALUES (= forcefield.RUNNABLE_FIELDS) admits it as a preferred_ff override. guides/ff_moiety_rules.json screens it, the EMC server accepts it, and rules_common maps it onto the pcff hardware family.
errata.does_the_conclusion_survive: Yes, on measured grounds the adjudicator did not have. `forcefield.py capability` (real EMC trial build) on 2026-09-11: compass CANNOT type PSU or PEEK -- EMC aborts with core/fields.c:436 FieldsApply 'Missing rules' -- while pcff types and builds both. EMC ships the PUBLISHED COMPASS subset, not the commercial full parameterisation, and that subset has no rules for an aryl-ether-sulfone or an aryl-ether-ketone. PSU and PEEK stay on pcff because it is the only field that builds them, not because compass is unavailable.
errata.new_fact_it_exposed: compass DOES type PEG (*CCO*) and is a genuine buildable alternative there. In the same probe the critic's own recommendation for PEG, opls/2024/opls-aa, FAILS to type it: core/script/field/entry.c:651 'Missing force field parameters'. Had the adjudicator applied the suggested override instead of declining it, PEG_1 would not have built at all.
errata.lesson: A capability claim about the codebase is checkable and must be checked, not asserted from memory. `forcefield.py capability <smiles> --fields <a,b>` answers it with a real EMC trial build in seconds, and it is the same probe make_deterministic_plan runs under --with-ff-probe -- but only when a moiety rule matches, which is why none of these four SMILES triggered one.
errata.action_taken: Recorded here rather than by editing PSU_1's run_plan.json: that plan is executing and its plan_hash is the stage-state key.

resolution.process_fix: The adjudicator could not verify capability claims: it held Read and cat/jq/grep/sed but NOT the probe, and nothing in its prompt told it to check the critic's claims. nodes._VERIFY_FIRST now instructs it to verify every claim it relies on -- the critic's, the plan's autofill evidence, and its own -- and the forcefield.py tool grant lets it actually run the EMC trial build.
resolution.re_adjudication: PEG_1's adjudication was re-run through the fixed adjudicator with a neutral operator fact-correction (COMPASS is runnable; treat prior capability claims as unverified; no outcome prejudged). It probed pcff, compass, three OPLS variants and gaff2 itself, and kept pcff.
adjudicator_reasons_against_compass: opls/2024/opls-aa DECLINED on measurement, not argument: types_smiles=false, 'Missing force field parameters'. It also noted the driver's own _apply_field_change would have popped the override anyway, so writing it would have been inert.

compass EVALUATED ON ITS MERITS and declined -- a field neither the plan nor the critic named. Nothing in the repo ranks it above pcff for an aliphatic polyether, and the two places the repo compares them cut against a swap: PVNL's ff_note records a COMPASS PVC study at K=2.947 GPa overlapping PolyJarvis's own PCFF 2.7-2.9 GPa ('two independent Class-II variants converge ... switching to COMPASS would likely not fix it'), and PSTR's ff_note -- the one documented COMPASS advantage, an aromatic-ring density deficit -6.3% -> -1.1% -- is aromatic-specific and PEO is not aromatic.

It corrected two of its own prior findings: the protocol-coherence argument was sound for OPLS-AA but must not generalise (compass's required_styles are byte-identical to pcff's), and 'NkepsuMbitou2025 has no resolvable DOI' was false -- it resolves in polymer_rules.json _metadata.primary_sources to 10.1016/j.commatsci.2025.113861.
It UPGRADED the row's parameter_coverage evidence from 'NOT MEASURED for this SMILES' to measured: pcff types and builds *CCO* to a runnable cell.
resolution.outcome: PEG_1 runs on pcff -- the adjudicator's judgment, reached with correct facts and its own measurements, and followed. An operator switch to compass was applied and then REVERTED so the decision would be the adjudicator's rather than the operator's.

incidents.what: PE_1 terminated escalation_required with build, equilibration and cooling all ACCEPTED and thermal never having run a single MD step. Both of its two recovery-agent calls were spent on lost GPU claim races, one at the cooling boundary (21:52Z) and one at thermal (23:02Z). No scientific question was asked by either.
incidents.mechanism: gpu_claim is scoped to each SUBMISSION, so a run releases its card at every stage boundary and re-races for one. Two independent defects made losing that race fatal: (a) free_gpus() required mem_used_mb <= 800, and a neighbour's 4-GPU training job grew from 754 MB to 5.8 GB per card, disqualifying every GPU at once on 40 GB A800s with 34 GB free; (b) _transient_retry_blocked DECLINED whenever no GPU was free, and declining escalates to the recovery agent.
fixes: bceab9f - free_gpus() asks whether our run FITS (mem_free_mb >= 8 GB), not whether the card is pristine.

073a06a - claim waits (polling 15 s, bounded) instead of failing at once, and claims atomically via O_EXCL rather than read-then-write, which also closed a last-writer-wins race that could put two PPPM runs on one card (~8x slower aggregate).

hardware_runtime DEFAULT_CLAIM_WAIT_S - the patience defaults inside the claim itself, because a campaign already running has run_campaign.py in memory but invokes hardware_runtime.py as a fresh subprocess. That is what fixed the three live runs mid-flight.
2d0d06b - _apply_remedy waits RESOURCE_WAIT_S for a busy resource and escalates only if it is still missing at the deadline. A structurally broken run directory still escalates at once.
incidents.verification: PEEK_1 and PSU_1 crossed the identical equilibration->cooling boundary at ~03:10Z with zero escalations and zero remedies, both on accepted_attempt-0001 with 12/12 binding gates evaluated and passing.
incidents.pe_1_disposition: Operator-approved reset, 2026-09-12: thermal returned to pending and the two infrastructure escalations moved to agent_escalations_archived_infrastructure so the audit trail survives while the MAX_AGENT_DECISIONS budget is restored for science. build/equilibration/cooling remain accepted -- ~2.9 GPU-h preserved, ~1.7 GPU-h left. Requeued behind a lane gate.
incidents.lesson: An orchestrator's scarcest resource is its agent-decision budget, and nothing in the engine stopped infrastructure from consuming it. Resource unavailability is a reason to WAIT; only a scientific finding should be allowed to spend a decision.

operator_decisions.decision: ACCEPTED by the operator. The measurement passed its own reportability gate and sits inside the experimental band; what failed is a leave-one-out CONVERGENCE advisory that assess_ladder_convergence documents as uncalibrated and meant for review. The recovery agent returned action=stop rather than spend a rung, and recommended acceptance with an annotation by a human.
operator_decisions.annotation_carried: LOO shift driven by P~0 anchor; K' decreases with P over the 1-15000 atm ladder (rubbery-to-stiffened crossover); Murnaghan B0 likely slightly high vs the low-P secant (1.58 GPa) and fluctuation (1.77 GPa) estimates; do not widen the ladder.
operator_decisions.agent_evidence: Only the P~0 drop breaks the 10% LOO threshold (+13.65%); the other five stay within 6.2%. That point is not noise: its NPT volumes scatter 96553-97895 A^3 with no trend, SEM 46. Local secant moduli back-projected to P=0 fall from ~1.97 GPa mid-ladder to ~1.5 at 15000 atm, i.e. K' decreases with pressure -- a rubbery PE cell at 300 K (exp Tg 195 K) stiffening toward glass under compression. Dropping the P~0 anchor forces extrapolation to V0 from high-pressure points obeying a different K'.
operator_decisions.declined: mechanical_resample_points=[500] -- the one rung the agent called reasonable. It stated it could not show the rung clears the 10% gate and that it would not change the best estimate. Raising the compression ceiling was explicitly ruled out: the next ladder point would be 30000 atm, further from the constant-K' regime.
operator_decisions.consequence: PE_1 reached accepted 6/6, its protocol froze with ff=trappe-ua -- the only non-PCFF system in the set, and therefore the real test of the preferred_ff freeze fix -- and PE_2/PE_3 unblocked.

operator_decisions.decision: Branch each deviating replicate back to the cell before its extra segment and re-run only what descended from it, instead of redoing the runs.

per_run.PEG_2: cooling attempt-0001 accepted (attempt-0002's 0.5 ns continuation superseded); mechanical + summary re-run. PEG_2's Tg already valid -- its staircase read equilibration attempt-0004, reached by identical-parameter retries.
per_run.PE_3: one 0.5 ns continuation (PE_1's exact parameters) from cooling attempt-0001, past five superseded attempts; agent-revised 0.6 ns removed from the plan; then thermal, mechanical, summary.
per_run.PE_2: equilibration attempt-0001 accepted (2.0 ns continuation superseded); cooling run fresh (npt_final, then PE_1's exact 0.5 ns continuation), then thermal, mechanical, summary.

operator_decisions.caveat: Every branch cell is the one that FAILED a gate (that is why the extra segment ran): PEG_2 cooling energy_drift; PE_3 cooling energy_drift + n_eff_density; PE_2 equilibration energy_component_drift. The gate verdict is recorded honestly (EXTEND), not as PASS. This is what strict replay would have produced anyway.
method: Accepted the earlier attempt under ITS OWN input_hash, which predates the remedy keys, and stripped those keys -- so reconcile_inputs does not invalidate it and re-run the stage.

Promoted the accept-path outputs a halted attempt never recorded (cool_verdict/equil_verdict, density from its own gate JSON, log/json paths) from what that attempt actually measured; originals kept under outputs_before_promotion.
Superseded later attempts rather than deleting them: _new_attempt numbers from len(attempts), so the list must keep matching the directories.
Executor prior_attempts walks now skip superseded attempts, so a continuation cannot chain from a discarded segment.

Pinned every parameter-changing remedy route at its cap; identical-parameter transient_retry left available (operator decision). Re-runs launched with NO recovery agent, so a gate failure stops for the operator instead of invoking an agent.

Each surgery rehearsed first on a scratch copy against a stub executor with real policy hashes: confirmed no reconcile invalidation, the exact cell each downstream stage reads, and zero remedies/escalations on a forced failure.

results_replicate_1.note: All four replicate-1 runs accepted 6/6. Density: PE +1.0% (TraPPE-UA), the three PCFF systems -4.5 to -5.5% -- the same sign and size across three unrelated chemistries, i.e. a force-field offset rather than a per-system error. Tg: PSU +4.0%; PE +20.1% and PEG +26.0% are the documented cooling-rate limit for rubbery members; PEEK +32.1% is the documented PCFF overprediction for rigid aromatics. Every bulk modulus lands inside its experimental band.

findings.what: PEG_2 failed its equilibration three times, every time inside the 625 K anneal (anneal_heat ~997k steps, anneal_heat ~952k steps, anneal_hold ~268k steps), while PEG_1 ran the IDENTICAL frozen protocol to completion on a different seed with a clean anneal (T 298-636 K heat, 609-643 K hold, no warnings).
findings.diagnosis: Integration instability, not hardware. The three signatures are one cause: 'ERROR: Out of range atoms - cannot compute PPPM' (pppm_kokkos.cpp:1150) is a physics failure -- atoms left the PPPM grid -- and the two cudaErrorIllegalAddress aborts are that same out-of-bounds grid index expressed as a GPU memory fault. Hardware was checked and cleared as far as this host allows: ECC errors 0 on all four A800s, no retired or remapped pages, and GPU 1 (where all three attempts ran) was concurrently running PSU_3 and had earlier run PE_1's equilibration. Xid could not be checked -- dmesg requires privileges -- so that remains the one open gap.
findings.why_it_matters: The campaign's claim is that replicates share a protocol and differ only by seed. That assumes the protocol is ROBUST across seeds. POXI's frozen protocol is only marginally stable at its anneal temperature with dt_fs=1.0, so whether a given seed survives is stochastic. That is a property of the protocol worth reporting, not merely an obstacle to running it.
findings.action: Retried unchanged, by operator decision. Editing dt_fs or annealing_T_high_K to rescue one seed would mean PEG_1 and PEG_2/3 no longer shared a protocol, which is the one thing the campaign may not trade away. The three failures stopped at very different points (997k / 952k / 268k steps), i.e. large run-to-run variation, which is what makes an unchanged retry worth one attempt.
findings.if_it_recurs: Report PEG at whatever n survives, with this instability as the finding. The principled fix -- dt_fs=0.5 for POXI, or a lower annealing_T_high_K -- changes a class-calibrated constant and requires re-running PEG_1 as well.

causes: The replay path runs the full recovery ladder: remedies and agent escalations are enabled for replicates, so a replicate failing a gate is extended, retried or revised exactly as replicate 1 was.

FREEZE_KEYS omit replicate 1's remedy-driven executed choices: PE_1 itself ran a 0.5 ns cooling continuation, but cooling_continuation_* are not frozen, so no PE replicate could replay PE_1 even with zero escalations.
Grading comparators are not frozen: PSU_2 and PSU_3 lack PSU_1's experimental_density_gcm3=1.24 (no trajectory affected; grading only).
verify_replicates.py compared PLAN decided_params, not executed effective_parameters, remedies or escalations -- so its earlier PASS did not establish this claim.
findings.topology_fact_used: The Tg staircase branches from the EQUILIBRATION melt cell; bulk modulus and 300 K density branch from the COOLING cell (confirmed on PE_1, PE_2, PEG_1, PEG_2). So an extra cooling segment contaminates K and density only; an extra equilibration segment contaminates everything downstream.

findings.question: Why did PE_1's cooling stop after one 0.5 ns continuation?
findings.answer: Its gate passed on the continuation -- but on a window with a tenth of the statistical power, while the drift itself grew.
defects: Continuations are measured standalone: LAMMPS continues the trajectory (steps 2500000 -> 2750000, 'log npt_final.log append'), but the log appends into a fresh file in the new attempt's directory, so the gate analyses only the continuation's 251 rows.

The 'one more window' extension resolved to 0.5 ns, not npt_final's 5 ns: PE_1's stage8_min_steps is 2500000 (5 ns at 2 fs) and the executed 0.5 ns equals the cooling call site's 0.5 ns fallback exactly. The remedy text recorded in remedy_history (max(1.5, ...)) does not describe what ran.
findings.consequence: PE_1's executed cooling is effectively a fixed schedule -- 5 ns at 300 K plus 0.5 ns, with density and K measured on the continuation cell -- and the PASS verdict on the 0.5 ns window is not a convergence signal. Replicates replay that schedule; the defects are deliberately NOT fixed mid-campaign, since fixing them would give PE_2/PE_3 a different continuation from PE_1.

findings.method: For every replicate 2/3 vs replicate 1, per stage: the accepted attempt's executor_state parameters (seeds excluded), the accepted chain length including continuation sources, the multiset of LAMMPS `run N` lines across the chain, the upstream stages its decks read from, plus remedy_history and live agent_escalations.
findings.result: No executed simulation parameter, schedule, upstream cell or gate input differs from replicate 1 except seeds. 30 raw differences, all classified:

classified_differences.what: experimental_tg_K / experimental_density_gcm3 / exp_K_min_GPa / exp_K_max_GPa present in PE_1 and PSU_1 params, absent in PE_2/PE_3/PSU_2/PSU_3
classified_differences.why: R1's adjudicator pinned them as plan overrides; the cache replay does not freeze overrides.
classified_differences.impact: none on execution: experimental_tg_K resolves from the class table to the same value (PE 195 K), experimental_density_gcm3 has no consumer (workflow_engine PARAMETER_STAGE comment), exp_K_range has no consumer anywhere in mcp-servers, run_summary does no experimental grading; mechanical outputs have identical key sets and gate fields.

classified_differences.what: Tg sweep: PEEK_2 ran one extra 200 000-step hold at 690 K (tg_step_T690_e1); PSU_1 ran one at 600 K that PSU_2/PSU_3 did not
classified_differences.why: _run_tg_sweep_adaptive extends a single temperature point when its density window is unstable or n_eff is below tg_per_t_min_n_eff; thresholds identical across replicates, triggered by each run's own data. Both extended points ended PASS (n_eff 56 and 103) and lie in the melt, >100 K above Tg.
classified_differences.impact: in-stage adaptive sampling, not a remedy or protocol choice; recorded so a strict step-for-step reading of 'identical protocol' is not claimed.

findings.method: benchmarks/stereo_r2/regrade_gates.py re-applied to every accepted equilibration and cooling attempt of the 12 runs; thermo recomputed from the log the live gate read, chain/spatial sections reused; data/ untouched.
findings.result: 20 of 24 stage gates PASS under both versions. Differences and remaining failures:
findings.reading: The new per-term criterion clears energy drift on PE_2 equilibration and on PE_2/PE_3 cooling; PE_2/PE_3 cooling still fail n_eff_density alone (window-invariant, F-03) and PEG_2 cooling still fails energy_drift. All four were accepted by recorded operator decisions; no run state was changed.

deferred_fixes.not_now_because: fixing either mid-campaign would give PE_2/PE_3 a different continuation from PE_1 and break the replay
defects: Continuations measured standalone: the gate analyses only the continuation's own log/dump in its new attempt directory, not the appended trajectory (run_campaign cooling/equilibration continuation paths; check_equilibration_comprehensive).

Cooling extension sizing falls back to 0.5 ns instead of reading stage8_min_steps (run_campaign._cool_stage_ns at the EXTEND call site), and _thermo_extension_ns's n_eff formula assumes the window grows.

check_equilibration_comprehensive._load_and_analyze: n_frames_used = n_frames_total - skip_frames goes negative on a short continuation dump (PE_3: 44 frames vs skip 50) and fails PROCESS_FAILED deterministically.
n_eff_density can be window-invariant for slowly relaxing cells (ACF summed to first zero crossing); EXTEND cannot clear it and should detect that across rungs.
remedy_history records a continue_npt remedy text (max(1.5, ...)) that does not describe the extension actually executed.

replicate_statistics.note: Sample SD over 3 replicates of the same frozen protocol, seeds only differing. PSU_2 and PEEK_2 Tg are TG_REVIEW (operator accepted as not reportable, 2026-09-13); both 'all' and 'reportable_only' are given and neither is preferred here. No experimental grading is applied.
